test_cases.notes: Check that model has two inputs: encoder_input and decoder_input

test_cases.description: Encoder LSTM returns states, and decoder LSTM uses them as initial_state
test_cases.input: encoder_outputs = seq2seq_model.layers[1].output; decoder_layer = seq2seq_model.layers[3]; assert len(decoder_layer.input_shape) == 3
test_cases.notes: Decoder should have three inputs: decoder_input, initial_h, initial_c

test_cases.description: Model can be fit on dummy one-hot data of correct shape
test_cases.input: dummy_X_enc = np.zeros((10, max_input_len, num_chars)); dummy_X_dec = np.zeros((10, max_target_len, num_chars)); dummy_y = np.zeros((10, max_target_len, num_chars)); seq2seq_model.train_on_batch([dummy_X_enc, dummy_X_dec], dummy_y)
test_cases.notes: Confirms model accepts batched one-hot inputs and produces loss

learning_objectives: Understand the encoder-decoder formulation of recurrent sequence-to-sequence learning.
Implement teacher-forced seq2seq training with Keras.
Connect training-time seq2seq modeling with inference-time decoding.
payload.course_context: Keras Code Examples / Machine translation / Character-level recurrent sequence-to-sequence model
